title: marsdawn open --json: success
description: Printed on stdout as one line when `marsdawn open --json` succeeds (exit code 0). marsdawn 0.5.1 and later.

path.description: Absolute path of the file that was opened.

line.description: The line MarsDawn was asked to land on. Present only when one was asked for.

opened.description: The files that were opened, in the order given. Empty when only a folder was given.

app.description: Path of the MarsDawn app that opened them.

path.description: Absolute path of the folder MarsDawn was asked to show in the window's sidebar.

requested.description: Always true: marsdawn asked the app to show the folder. It can't tell whether the sidebar shows it, since the app may first ask the user for access. Report it as asked, not as done.

folder.description: Present only when a folder was given, as an argument (marsdawn open .) or with --folder.
